Skill `deploy-iac-execution-health-verification`.
Roles: `agent`, `user`.
Tool `read_subagent_preflight` (owner `agent`): via `read`; adds `subagent_preflight_read`.
Tool `dispatch_preflight_task` (owner `agent`): via `agent`; requires `subagent_preflight_read`; needs `sub_agents`; adds `preflight_dispatched`, `deploy_checklist_written`.
Tool `read_deploy_checklist` (owner `agent`): via `read`; requires `deploy_checklist_written`; adds `deploy_checklist_read`.
Tool `read_upstream_artifacts` (owner `agent`): via `read`; adds `prepare_plan_read`, `scaffold_manifest_read`, `validation_checked`, `deployment_variables_resolved`.
Tool `read_deploy_schema` (owner `agent`): via `read`; adds `deploy_schema_read`.
Tool `write_deploy_result_skeleton` (owner `agent`): via `write`; requires `deploy_schema_read`; adds `deploy_result_exists`, `deploy_result_in_progress`.
Tool `run_preflight_checks` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `deploy_checklist_read` and `prepare_plan_read` and `scaffold_manifest_read` and `validation_checked` and `deployment_variables_resolved` and `deploy_result_exists`; needs `shell`, `linux`; adds `preflight_passed`, `what_if_completed`, `auth_checked`, `rbac_checked`, `rg_checked`.
Tool `ask_deploy_approval` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; requires `preflight_passed`; adds `approval_answered`; picks `approved` with (`approved` or not `approved`).
Tool `execute_deployment_and_code` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `approved` and `deploy_checklist_read` and `prepare_plan_read` and `deployment_variables_resolved` and `deploy_result_exists`; needs `shell`, `linux`; adds `portal_link_generated`, `deployment_executed`, `code_deployed`, `secure_params_generated_or_reused`.
Tool `health_check_and_disable_scm` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `deployment_executed` and `code_deployed` and `deploy_checklist_read`; needs `shell`, `linux`; adds `health_checked`, `scm_disabled_verified`; picks `healthy` with (`healthy` or not `healthy`).
Tool `read_error_classification` (owner `agent`): via `read`; adds `error_classification_read`.
Tool `heal_deployment` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `error_classification_read` and `deploy_checklist_read`; needs `shell`, `linux`; adds `healing_attempt_made`; picks `healing_attempts` with `healing_attempts` >= 1; picks `healthy` with (`healthy` or not `healthy`).
Tool `ask_healing_continue` (owner `agent`): via `ask_user`; requires `healing_attempt_made`; adds `healing_user_answered`; picks `healing_continue` with (`healing_continue` or not `healing_continue`).
Tool `finalize_artifacts` (owner `agent`): via `write`; requires `deploy_schema_read` and `deploy_result_exists`; adds `deploy_result_finalized`, `deployment_summary_written`, `context_updated`, `deploy_phase_completed`; removes `deploy_result_in_progress`.
Initially true: none.
Initially: `healing_attempts` == 0.
Goal: `deploy_result_exists` and `deploy_result_finalized` and `deployment_summary_written` and `context_updated` and `deploy_phase_completed` and not `deploy_result_in_progress`.
Protocol:
  - `agent` uses `read_subagent_preflight`.
  - `agent` uses `dispatch_preflight_task`.
  - `agent` uses `read_deploy_checklist`.
  - `agent` uses `read_upstream_artifacts`.
  - `agent` uses `read_deploy_schema`.
  - `agent` uses `write_deploy_result_skeleton`.
  - `agent` uses `run_preflight_checks`.
  - `agent` uses `ask_deploy_approval`.
  - `user` chooses one of (observed):
    - branch `approve`:
      - `agent` uses `execute_deployment_and_code`.
      - `agent` uses `read_deploy_checklist`.
      - `agent` uses `health_check_and_disable_scm`.
      - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
        - branch `healthy`:
          - `agent` uses `read_deploy_schema`.
          - `agent` uses `read_deploy_checklist`.
          - `agent` uses `finalize_artifacts`.
        - branch `needs_healing`:
          - `agent` uses `read_error_classification`.
          - loop `healing_loop`:
            - `agent` uses `read_deploy_checklist`.
            - `agent` uses `heal_deployment`.
            - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
              - branch `recovered`: none.
              - branch `continue_healing`:
                - `agent` chooses one of (observed):
                  - branch `ask_user_after_threshold`:
                    - `agent` uses `ask_healing_continue`.
                    - `user` chooses one of (observed):
                      - branch `continue`:
                        - repeat `healing_loop`.
                      - branch `stop`: none.
                  - branch `retry_without_user`:
                    - repeat `healing_loop`.
          - `agent` uses `read_deploy_schema`.
          - `agent` uses `read_deploy_checklist`.
          - `agent` uses `finalize_artifacts`.
    - branch `deny`:
      - `agent` uses `read_deploy_schema`.
      - `agent` uses `finalize_artifacts`.
